explanation: An offering sacrificed to God to atone for sin and obtain forgiveness.
An accidental error or action, in this context a sin committed without intent.
The supreme religious leader of the Israelite priesthood, responsible for performing sacrifices and other ritual acts.
An offering given to God on behalf of the entire community to atone for their sins.
An act or thought that breaks God's laws and commands, leading to separation from God.
The blood from a sacrificial animal used in ritual actions to cleanse and atone for sin.
An animal sacrificed to God as part of a ritual, typically an innocent and unblemished creature.
